content:
Delighted to be celebrating 80 years of Air France flying between Manchester Airport and Paris! 

From a single Dakota flight in 1946 to up to four daily flights today, now operated by the Airbus A220. This route continues to play a vital role in connecting the Northwest of England via Paris Charles de Gaulle to nearly 170 destinations across 83 countries.

Here’s to many more years to come. 

#AirFrance #ManchesterAirport
